g.text: Ink body. The cards run the whole brand deck on a Cream
underbase: Light Sky, Salt Pink, Light Pink, Sego Lily, Sage,
Meadow, Forest, Aspen Gold, Terracotta, Rodeo Red, Navy.
Paper line: the same six as a boxed card set, offset on
uncoated stock, with the game sheet.
Six cards drawn in Don Clemente proportions, numeral top left, the name on the foot rule, and the numbers are facts, not a sequence:
02 for the TRAX line that opened for 2002, 11 for the Wasatch in thousands of feet, 03 for al pastor three to a plate, 26 for the north arm's
salinity, 21 for the 21 cysts per liter the state leaves in the lake at season's end, 47 for 1847 and the jaripeo weekend. The board goes on
the back of a heavyweight black tee at eleven inches wide, flat spot color so it feels like card stock, and El Camarón rides the left chest.
The same six become a boxed card set in the paper line. El Lowrider, La Tejana and La Arepa are the second drop.
These drawings are blocking. A Salt Lake County illustrator redraws all six in a lotería hand; the misregistration and grain stay on purpose.
